query: MATCH (sec:Section) OPTIONAL MATCH (sec)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(tbl:TSTable) WITH sec,count(DISTINCT tbl) AS tableCount WHERE tableCount>=3 OPTIONAL MATCH (sec)-[:HAS_SUB_SECTION]->(sub:Section) WITH sec,tableCount,count(DISTINCT sub) AS subSectionCount WHERE subSectionCount>=1 RETURN sec.sectionId AS sectionId,tableCount,subSectionCount ORDER BY tableCount DESC,subSectionCount DESC,sectionId ASC LIMIT 10
